# Environment reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-env-doc.py — do not edit; run the script after changing docker-compose.yml -->

Every variable `docker-compose.yml` passes to the `api` container (312). Set them in `.env` (same folder as the compose file). A variable that is in `.env` but not in this list never reaches the container. Empty default = the default of the code. Feature switches (`SOKKAN_FEATURE_*`) are described one by one in [enterprise/FEATURES.md](enterprise/FEATURES.md); the on-prem appliance profile in [appliance/README.md](appliance/README.md).

| Variable | Default | Read by | Notes (from docker-compose.yml) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | — | backend/assistant.py, backend/llm.py, backend/usage.py | BYOK — your Anthropic API key (or mount your ~/.claude, see README) |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` | — | backend/llm.py, backend/usage.py | subscription (Claude Pro/Max): token from `claude setup-token` |
| `SOKKAN_LOCAL_TOKEN` | — | backend/auth.py | access token asked on the login screen; leave empty for open access (only do that on a trusted network) |
| `SOKKAN_OWNER_EMAIL` | `owner@localhost` | backend/agents_mcp.py, backend/auth.py, backend/demo_captains.py | access token asked on the login screen; leave empty for open access (only do that on a trusted network) |
| `SOKKAN_OWNER_NAME` | `Owner` | backend/auth.py, backend/iam.py, backend/instance.py | access token asked on the login screen; leave empty for open access (only do that on a trusted network) |
| `SOKKAN_TZ` | `Europe/Zurich` | backend/memeval.py, backend/teams/outreach.py, backend/usage.py | access token asked on the login screen; leave empty for open access (only do that on a trusted network) |
| `SOKKAN_PUBLIC_URL` | `http://localhost:3009` | backend/alerting/channels.py, backend/app.py, backend/corthexis.py | access token asked on the login screen; leave empty for open access (only do that on a trusted network) |
| `SOKKAN_TIER` | — | backend/assistant.py, backend/features.py, backend/instance.py | access token asked on the login screen; leave empty for open access (only do that on a trusted network) |
| `SOKKAN_VERSION` | `dev` | backend/app.py, backend/assistant.py, backend/heartbeat.py | daily update check (see .env.example); version written by install.sh |
| `SOKKAN_UPDATE_CHECK` | `1` | backend/features.py | daily update check (see .env.example); version written by install.sh |
| `ML_SERVICE_URL` | — | memory/embeddings.py, memory/memory_migration.py | optional remote embedding service; empty = local ONNX (fastembed) |
| `SOKKAN_EMBED_MODEL` | — | memory/embeddings.py, memory/memory_migration.py | 2.x custom fastembed model: serves the 2.x index during the migration and, with no SOKKAN_MEMORY_PROFILE, maps to the `legacy` profile (declared here: a variable only in .env never reaches the container — the 2.0.1 trap) |
| `CORTHEXIS_MEMORY_PROFILE` (`.env`: `SOKKAN_MEMORY_PROFILE`) | — | memory/core/embed.py, memory/core/models.py, memory/memory_migration.py | memory profile (leger \| standard \| gpu; written by scripts/memory-setup.sh). Empty = 2.x behaviour: `remote` when ML_SERVICE_URL is set, else leger. |
| `CORTHEXIS_MODELS_DIR` | `/models` | memory/core/models.py | memory profile (leger \| standard \| gpu; written by scripts/memory-setup.sh). Empty = 2.x behaviour: `remote` when ML_SERVICE_URL is set, else leger. |
| `CORTHEXIS_EMBED_URLS` (`.env`: `SOKKAN_EMBED_URLS`) | — | memory/core/embed.py, memory/core/review.py, memory/core/switch.py | optional overrides: embedding servers tried in order (e.g. a Magnitude GPU node, then the local container) and reranker URL ("off" disables it) |
| `CORTHEXIS_RERANK_URL` (`.env`: `SOKKAN_RERANK_URL`) | — | memory/core/embed.py, memory/core/switch.py | optional overrides: embedding servers tried in order (e.g. a Magnitude GPU node, then the local container) and reranker URL ("off" disables it) |
| `CORTHEXIS_DATABASE_URL` | — | backend/heartbeat.py, memory/core/review.py, memory/core/store.py | memory engine (CortHeXis) 3.0: Postgres + pgvector store of the `db` service, filled by the 3.0 indexer (start, file changes, every CORTHEXIS_REINDEX_S). auto = an existing 2.x memory is migrated at the first start (archive, normalize, dates, generation 1 — see docs/UPGRADE.md) while memory.db keeps serving, then the store serves (a new install goes straight to the store); sqlite = stay on the 2.x index; postgres = the store only, no migration. empty = the `db` service below (memory/store_backend.py builds the URL from SOKKAN_DB_PASSWORD: a nested default here needs Docker Compose 2.20+) |
| `SOKKAN_DB_PASSWORD` | `sokkan` | memory/store_backend.py | memory engine (CortHeXis) 3.0: Postgres + pgvector store of the `db` service, filled by the 3.0 indexer (start, file changes, every CORTHEXIS_REINDEX_S). auto = an existing 2.x memory is migrated at the first start (archive, normalize, dates, generation 1 — see docs/UPGRADE.md) while memory.db keeps serving, then the store serves (a new install goes straight to the store); sqlite = stay on the 2.x index; postgres = the store only, no migration. empty = the `db` service below (memory/store_backend.py builds the URL from SOKKAN_DB_PASSWORD: a nested default here needs Docker Compose 2.20+) |
| `CORTHEXIS_MEMORY_BACKEND` | `auto` | memory/store_backend.py | memory engine (CortHeXis) 3.0: Postgres + pgvector store of the `db` service, filled by the 3.0 indexer (start, file changes, every CORTHEXIS_REINDEX_S). auto = an existing 2.x memory is migrated at the first start (archive, normalize, dates, generation 1 — see docs/UPGRADE.md) while memory.db keeps serving, then the store serves (a new install goes straight to the store); sqlite = stay on the 2.x index; postgres = the store only, no migration. empty = the `db` service below (memory/store_backend.py builds the URL from SOKKAN_DB_PASSWORD: a nested default here needs Docker Compose 2.20+) |
